description: This file defines an Angular component called NoteDetailComponent, which manages displaying the details of a single note, handling deletion confirmation, and navigation after deletion.

classes.name: NoteDetailComponent
classes.description: Angular component responsible for displaying detailed view of a note, with capabilities to delete and navigate.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that retrieves the note by ID when the component initializes.

methods.name: onSaved
methods.description: Handler to update the note when saved in a child component.

methods.name: requestDelete
methods.description: Triggers opening of the delete confirmation dialog.

methods.name: onConfirmDelete
methods.description: Handles user's confirmation, deletes the note if confirmed, and navigates to the root page.
